scope.activation: At least one exact RAG question has two semantically stable internal answers that contradict its RAG answer, and that RAG answer selected evidence.
scope.same_model_requirement: The original victim reruns the answer and verdict stages.
scope.development_warning: The intervention gate was evaluated on development labels. Results are method development, not confirmation.

intervention.removed_unit: Every anonymous document identity selected by an eligible conflicting question.
intervention.global_removal: Remove the identity from all ten existing retrieval groups.

adoption_gate.default_prediction: The frozen low-rate corroboration candidate remains unchanged.
requirements: Any guarded extension is at least as accurate as the frozen candidate at clean, 0.1%, 0.25%, and 0.5% pooled.
It is strictly better in at least one attacked condition.
It introduces no more than one net loss for any victim across the three attacked conditions.
All override gains, regressions, activations, and claim-clustered uncertainty are reported.
adoption_gate.failure_action: Retain the frozen candidate and report fixed-context removal as mechanistic analysis only.

private_evaluation_only: whether a removed document was poisoned
